data.gender_notes: Cody is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'codda', meaning 'helpful one'. In Christian tradition, Cody is often associated with the courage and strength of a warrior for the Lord. The name has been popularized in contemporary media, including television and literature. The name Cody carries the meaning “Brave warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Cody usually hope their child will grow to embody brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and courage needed to follow God's path.
data.etymology: Cody belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cody total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Cody carries a connotation of hardiness and resilience. It has been popularized in popular media, including the famous Western film character "Cody Jarret" portrayed by Paul Newman in "The Left Handed Gun". This tough-as-nails persona has influenced the perception of the name, particularly in American culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Cody can be interpreted as a name symbolizing the Christian virtues of courage, strength, and assistance. Derived from the Old English word 'codda', which means a 'helpful one', Cody represents someone who is in tune with the divine and imbued with the courage to stand up for their faith. A Cody is a spiritual warrior, one who provides help and support to those around them in fulfillment of God's command to "love thy neighbor."
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cody: Derived from the Old English word "code," meaning helper or companion, reflecting the belief that every Christian is called to support and uplift others on their spiritual journey.

historical_references.reference: Saint Codegisel, a Breton saint, is believed to have lived during the 6th century. He was a hermit and a healer, and is also known as Saint Coudou. His shrine was located in the forest of Quenec'h in Brittany, France, and was a popular pilgrimage site throughout the Middle Ages.

historical_references.reference: Cody Rudolf, an American football player, was born in 1992. He played college football at the University of Kentucky and was drafted by the Pittsburgh Steelers in the sixth round of the 2014 NFL Draft. He took the name 'Cody' as a nod to Cody Kessler, his college quarterback and close friend.

Overall, Cody is a versatile name that spans across programming, gaming, and music industries.
